# Aoto 1.0.2

New things, none of them needed. If you installed Aoto from the GitHub release, this installs over it without uninstalling.

## New

- **Update notifications.** Aoto now looks for a newer release twice a day, even when the app is closed, and tells you in a notification. Tap it to download the new APK; it installs over the old one, so there is nothing to uninstall. You are told once per version. You can turn the notifications off in Android's settings (the "App updates" channel).
- **Remove a download.** A downloaded song's menu now has *Remove download*, which deletes the file and takes the song off the Downloads list. It replaces *Show in folder*, which did nothing on Android. The copy in the folder you chose for downloads is left alone.
- **Pure black.** Settings › Appearance › *Pure black* gives dark mode a true black background, which saves battery on OLED screens. Cards and sheets stay dark grey so they stand out.
- **Lossless from addons.** Settings › Sound & quality › *Lossless from addons* chooses when an addon's lossless copy of a song (FLAC and the like) may play: *Always* (as before), *Wi-Fi only* (YouTube's stream is used on mobile data), or *Off*. The addons stay in the list.
- **Quality on Wi-Fi and on mobile data.** Settings › Sound & quality now has a *Low / Normal / High* choice for each kind of connection. High is what Aoto always played (the best your account gets); Normal is AAC 128 kbps and Low is about 48 kbps, for when mobile data is dear. Downloads always take the best.
- **Spatial audio strength.** *Light, Medium* or *Strong*. Strong, now the default, widens the stereo image much more and is easy to hear on ordinary earphones; Light is how it was.
- **Lossless downloads.** Settings › Downloads › *Save lossless when an addon has it* saves the addon's FLAC copy of a song, tagged with its title, artists, album, track number and cover, instead of YouTube's audio. Off by default: FLAC files are 4 to 8 times larger.
- **Lyrics in the file.** *Save lyrics in the file* (on by default) puts the song's lyrics in the tag of a download: timed lyrics as LRC, which players that show synced lyrics read, otherwise plain text.
- **Downloaded playlists stay up to date.** A playlist you downloaded whole is checked when the app opens and every six hours, and songs added to it since are downloaded too (on Wi-Fi only, if that is on). A song you removed from the phone is not fetched again. Turn it off with *Keep downloaded playlists up to date*.
- **Lossless on its way to your ears.** The audio quality details now say what the output does to a lossless song: wired and USB leave the phone uncompressed, Bluetooth compresses it (Aoto can't see which codec).
- **A lossless addon you can run yourself**, in the `addons/flac-library` folder of the source: a small server for your own FLAC files, with a guide for writing other addons.

## Notes

- The update notification is new and has been tried on few devices. Please report what breaks, with your phone model and Android version.
- Chromecast is still not supported.
